description: PAID (needs a key) — Use when a column should be filled by AI from other columns (the gender from the first name, a seniority from the job title). AI tokens by use (usually cents; at most 10 credits per call, within the key's day budget): fill an existing column from others by an instruction (e.g. the gender from the first name, a seniority from the job title, a country from the city). Unique values are asked once.

description.description: What to put in, e.g. "male, female or unknown from the first name"

filter.description: Column → value: exact, { "contains": "…" }, { "not": "…" }, { "is_empty": true } or { "condition": "<one of filter_conditions>" }; ar_status by status name

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list without list_id shows the lists shared with you)

name: derive_column
title: Derive a column
